name: Generate Random IBAN API
description: A small, versioned JSON API for generating and validating structurally valid (ISO 13616 / MOD-97) IBANs for 91 countries, with correct national check digits where the country defines them. An optional realistic mode uses real bank codes and digits only. Generated IBANs always pass checksum validation but were not issued by any bank: they are for testing, QA and education only, never for payments.
